name: Daylight -Asa ni Hikari no Kan o-
source:
The protagonist of the story, Luca, moves at the begining of the new semester from a private room to a double room. His new roommate is peculiar and gloomy senior, and he starts to arise his classmates' curiosities. 

After that, he has been nominated for the Morning Messenger at the school festival, which will take place 2 months later. It is an important role, which has to do with the mysterious ceremony. Not only he has to deal with this role, he also has to solve seven mysteries of the Academy, which will lead him to the secret of the "Legend".
translation:
新学期开始时，故事主人公卢卡从单人房搬进了双人房。他的新室友是一名性格古怪而阴郁的高年级学生，很快便引起了同学们的好奇。

此后，卢卡被选为两个月后学园祭中的“晨之使者”。这是一个与神秘仪式有关的重要职位。除了履行这一职责外，他还必须解开学园里的七大谜团，而这些谜团最终将把他引向“传说”的秘密。
